prose: Xiaomi released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series: two natively omnimodal models for coding, visual tasks and computer use, advanced through scaled reinforcement learning. MiMo-V2.6-Pro is the most capable, Flash targets a lower-cost balance, and a Pro-UltraSpeed variant offers up to 20x faster output at the same quality for latency-sensitive work.

Xiaomi says Pro performs on par with Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol across most agent benchmarks, scoring 46.32 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 - ahead of Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max as the highest-scoring open-source model in the comparison. API prices hold at V2.5 levels: Flash at $0.14/$0.28 per million uncached input/output tokens, Pro at $0.435 input.
highlights: MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash open-sourced; natively omnimodal for coding, vision and computer use.
Pro claims parity with Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on most agent benchmarks.
46.32 on Intelligence Index v4.3 - billed as the top open-source score, ahead of Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max.
Pro-UltraSpeed: up to 20x faster output at equal quality.
Pricing unchanged from V2.5: Flash $0.14/$0.28, Pro $0.435 input per million tokens.
